== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[AT-AT Cannon (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (<code>1220_83</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 83), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-83-AT_AT_Cannon.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-atatcannon-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[AT-AT Cannon (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip, drawn as icons. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on your non-[Maintenance] AT-AT. May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 (+2 if a vehicle) > defense value. If lost from table, place this weapon in Used Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1220_83</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 2 set mark, slip number 83 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-83-AT_AT_Cannon-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B05 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
